title: Create: Need My Metal Back
description: Recycle metal items, tools and armors to stock up on really useful stuff
body:
# Don't let them collect dust in your chest - crush them!

This addon makes it possible to return some metal by throwing metal things into crushing wheels. List of items includes both Minecraft and Create items. 

Things to recycle for iron, chains, gold, diamonds etc:
- Armors
- Tools 
- Weapons
- Anvils
- Buckets
- Minecarts
- Compasses
- Shields
- Cauldrons
- & More + Create stuff

See the gallery for some examples ->

_Create: Need My Metal Back was created after I purged a dungeon and looted all kinds of iron armors and weapons while running low on iron ingots at home. I did not want to go to the mines, nor wanted to wear iron as I had diamond gear already. So instead I would like to turn iron gear into iron, making this idea into a datapack._
